AMLBot Traces About 4 BTC From Bitget Hack Into Wasabi CoinJoin Crypto compliance and blockchain analytics platform AMLBot said some funds linked to the Bitget theft appear to have entered Wasabi CoinJoin. Its tracing linked roughly 4 BTC in one CoinJoin round back to a Bitget TRON wallet. The funds were converted from TRX to USDT, bridged to Ethereum via USDT0, swapped into about 145 ETH, then routed through THORChain into roughly 4.59 BTC before being split and sent into CoinJoin. AMLBot said it has blacklisted the related addresses and is monitoring the attacker’s BTC for further CoinJoin activity. — link

Highlight Clip: Coinbase CEO Stands by His $400K Bitcoin Prediction for 2030 Coinbase CEO Stands by His $400K Bitcoin Prediction for 2030 Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong said in a September 19 interview with MoneyRehabPodcast that he still stands by his previous prediction that Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030.Armstrong said Bitcoin has historically followed roughly four-year cycles, with new supply halving approximately every four years. These cycles have typically included rallies followed by corrections lasting about a year. If Bitcoin follows a similar pattern again, he believes it could reach roughly three times its previous all-time high by 2030.However, Armstrong stressed that this is only a hypothetical scenario. Past performance does not predict future results, and the $400,000 target is far from guaranteed. — link

Highlight Clip: Capital B CEO: Bitcoin Is the Only Asset the U.S. Government Is Unwilling to Sell Capital B CEO: Bitcoin Is the Only Asset the U.S. Government Is Unwilling to Sell Capital B CEO Alexandre Laizet said in an interview at BTCPrague that the company plans to continue buying Bitcoin as quickly as possible and in the most accretive way, while holding it for the long term. He noted that financial institutions and corporations around the world are accelerating their adoption of Bitcoin, while the U.S. government has designated Bitcoin held in its strategic reserve as an asset not to be sold. Since most global capital can only gain exposure through securities markets, publicly listed companies can use equity and debt financing to expand their Bitcoin holdings and participate in the development of digital capital markets. — link

GoPlus Challenges THORChain’s Decentralization Claims Over DPRK-Linked Fund Flows GoPlus Security argued that THORChain should not compare itself directly with Bitcoin or Ethereum when defending its inability to block illicit flows. It said THORChain outbounds rely on threshold signatures from a relatively small active validator set, while the protocol already includes pause, per-chain signing halt and governance mechanisms. GoPlus pointed to prior intervention during THORChain’s own exploit and argued that FBI- or OFAC-attributed DPRK-linked funds could be blocked under the protocol’s existing emergency framework. — link
